dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I get two portions, too?

dialogues.speaker: Sereda
dialogues.text: If I were still working at my old little restaurant, I'd be sure to cook you up a few of my best dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Sereda
dialogues.text: But right now, I have to make sure the lads in the army are fed first.

dialogues.speaker: Sereda
dialogues.text: Once I retire, please do come by my little restaurant again!
